# Analysis Vendor Decoders

Codec block statistics are generated by instrumented decoder submodules. The
main VoidPlayer repository pins each submodule commit and only talks to the
decoder through a command line plus the VBS3 file format.

Current and planned producers:

| Codec | Submodule | Runtime tool dir | VBS3 writer switch |
|---|---|---|---|
| VVC/H.266 | `vtm` | `tools/vtm` | `VTM_BINARY_STATS`, `VTM_BINARY_STATS_FORMAT=VBS3` |
| HEVC/H.265 | `ffmpeg` | `tools/ffmpeg-analysis` | `void_ffmpeg_analyzer.exe --codec hevc --input <path> --vbs3 <path>` |

Add new producers as separate forks instead of committing patched decoder
sources directly into the main repository. After pushing a producer patch to
its fork, update the submodule pointer in this repository.

The FFmpeg analyzer is built out-of-band from the `ffmpeg` submodule. MSYS2 may
be used as the configure/make shell, but the runtime artifact must be a native
Windows executable without MSYS2, pthread, libgcc, or libstdc++ DLL imports.
